technical.summary: MCK shows strong trend structure with price above all major MAs and positive volume confirmation, but overbought oscillators with bearish stochastic cross and declining RSI momentum create pullback risk; moderate entry quality in neutral sector environment.

fundamental.summary: MCK shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 84 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional signal with junior member small-amount sales; broad market fear (31 score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but lack of recent news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (327.36) with imminent CPI event (0 days) creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 84-day earnings window mitigates binary risk but elevated volatility dominates risk profile.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with positive ADX/DI and rising OBV/CMF provides structural trend confirmation in a fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI with bearish stochastic cross, VIX crisis regime (327.36), imminent CPI event, weak fundamentals (score 3), and no smart money conviction create acute pullback/macro risk that outweighs technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is sound with price above all major MAs and positive volume, but overbought oscillators with bearish stochastic cross signal imminent pullback risk in a VIX crisis regime with zero fundamental or smart money support.
